info.title: lacewing-backend
info.description: Express + TypeScript backend demonstrating lacewing, the RFC 8725-first JWT library.

accessCookie.name: access_token
accessCookie.description: Set by login and refresh. Read before the bearer header.

bearerAuth.description: The access token, for clients that do not keep cookies. Strict RFC 6750: exactly one `Bearer <token>`.

refreshCookie.name: refresh_token
refreshCookie.description: Set by login and refresh, scoped to the refresh path.

csrfToken.name: x-csrf-token
csrfToken.description: The csrfToken from login, refresh or /auth/csrf-token. It must match the __csrf cookie and the session it was minted for.

get.description: Liveness only: it answers while the process is up and checks no dependency.
